audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Teaching, generational memory, rebellion, miracles, plagues, wilderness, war, David, and historical recital.

verses.restored: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

familiar.text: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

notes.title: Historical recital
notes.body: Psalm 78 retells Israel’s past theologically and poetically. Its purpose differs from modern critical historiography, and tensions with other biblical accounts should be preserved.

modern.text: Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.

original.text: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי פִֽי

verses.restored: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

familiar.text: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

modern.text: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,

original.text: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי קֶֽדֶם

verses.restored: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

familiar.text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

modern.text: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ לָֽנוּ

verses.restored: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of YHWH, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

familiar.text: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

modern.text: We will not hide them from their children, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.

original.text: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

familiar.text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

modern.text: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,

original.text: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

familiar.text: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

modern.text: that the coming generation would know them— even children yet to be born— to arise and tell their own children

original.text: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

familiar.text: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

modern.text: that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.

original.text: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ

verses.restored: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

familiar.text: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

modern.text: Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.

original.text: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ

verses.restored: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

familiar.text: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

modern.text: The archers of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle.

original.text: בְּֽנֵי אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב

verses.restored: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

familiar.text: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

modern.text: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law.

original.text: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת

verses.restored: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had showed them.

familiar.text: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

modern.text: They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם

verses.restored: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

familiar.text: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

modern.text: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

original.text: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה צֹֽעַן

verses.restored: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

familiar.text: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

modern.text: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.

original.text: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ נֵֽד

verses.restored: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

familiar.text: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

modern.text: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.

original.text: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם וְכָל הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה בְּא֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

familiar.text: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

modern.text: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.

original.text: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמ֥וֹת רַבָּֽה

verses.restored: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

familiar.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

modern.text: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.

original.text: וַיּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע וַיּ֖וֹרֶד כַּנְּהָר֣וֹת מָֽיִם

verses.restored: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

familiar.text: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

modern.text: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.

original.text: וַיּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַחֲטֹא ל֑וֹ לַֽמְר֥וֹת עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּצִּיָּֽה

verses.restored: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

familiar.text: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

modern.text: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.

original.text: וַיְנַסּוּ אֵ֥ל בִּלְבָבָ֑ם לִֽשְׁאָל אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם

verses.restored: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

familiar.text: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

modern.text: They spoke against God, saying, “Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?

original.text: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר

verses.restored: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

familiar.text: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

modern.text: When He struck the rock, water gushed out and torrents raged. But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat?”

original.text: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה צ֨וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲגַם לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְעַמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Therefore YHWH heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

familiar.text: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

modern.text: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and His anger flared against Israel,

original.text: לָכֵ֤ן שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

familiar.text: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

modern.text: because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.

original.text: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

familiar.text: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

modern.text: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.

original.text: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח

verses.restored: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

familiar.text: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

modern.text: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.

original.text: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וּדְגַן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ

verses.restored: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

familiar.text: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

modern.text: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.

original.text: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם לָשֹֽׂבַע

verses.restored: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

familiar.text: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

modern.text: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.

original.text: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג בְּעֻזּ֣וֹ תֵימָֽן

verses.restored: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

familiar.text: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

modern.text: He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.

original.text: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽכְח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים ע֣וֹף כָּנָֽף

verses.restored: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

familiar.text: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

modern.text: He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.

original.text: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

familiar.text: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

modern.text: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.

original.text: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝תַֽאֲוָתָ֗ם יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

familiar.text: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

modern.text: Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,

original.text: לֹא זָר֥וּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם ע֝֗וֹד אָכְלָ֥ם בְּפִיהֶֽם

verses.restored: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

familiar.text: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

modern.text: God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.

original.text: וְאַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ

verses.restored: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

familiar.text: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

modern.text: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.

original.text: בְּכָל זֹ֭את חָֽטְאוּ ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

familiar.text: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

modern.text: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.

original.text: וַיְכַל בַּהֶ֥בֶל יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝שְׁנוֹתָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה

verses.restored: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

familiar.text: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

modern.text: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.

original.text: אִם הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ אֵֽל

verses.restored: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

familiar.text: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

modern.text: And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

original.text: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם

verses.restored: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied to him with their tongues.

familiar.text: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

modern.text: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.

original.text: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בִלְשׁוֹנָ֗ם יְכַזְּבוּ לֽוֹ

verses.restored: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

familiar.text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

modern.text: Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.

original.text: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ

verses.restored: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

familiar.text: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

modern.text: And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.

original.text: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יָ֝עִיר כָּל חֲמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He remembered that they were flesh, a passing wind that does not return.

familiar.text: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

modern.text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

original.text: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּי בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב

verses.restored: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

familiar.text: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

modern.text: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!

original.text: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן

verses.restored: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

familiar.text: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

modern.text: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

original.text: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְווּ

verses.restored: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

familiar.text: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

modern.text: They did not remember His power — the day He redeemed them from the adversary,
